tests.title: adds a book and shows it in the list
tests.steps: Open the app; press Add; enter Title, Author, choose Category; save.
tests.expect: The new book appears in the list with its Title, Author, and Category.

tests.title: rejects an empty required field
tests.steps: Press Add; leave Title empty; save.
tests.expect: The form shows 'Title is required' and does not save.

tests.title: edits an existing book
tests.steps: Open a book; press Edit; change Title; save.
tests.expect: The book's Title is updated in the list.

tests.title: deletes a book added by mistake
tests.steps: Open a book; press Delete; confirm.
tests.expect: The book is removed from the list.

tests.title: lends a book and shows the borrower
tests.steps: Open a book; press Lend; enter a Borrower name; save.
tests.expect: The book shows the badge 'Lent to {borrower}'.

tests.title: returns a book and clears the borrower
tests.steps: Open a lent book; press Return.
tests.expect: The 'Lent to {borrower}' badge disappears and the Borrower is empty.

tests.title: filters to books currently lent out
tests.expect: Only books with a Borrower are shown.

tests.title: filters books by category
tests.expect: Only books whose Category is 'Novel' are shown.

tests.title: shows how many books are lent out
tests.expect: It shows the count of rows where borrower is not empty.

tests.title: preserves data across a browser refresh
tests.steps: Add or lend a book; refresh the browser.
tests.expect: All books, borrowers, and the 'Lent out' count remain unchanged.

implemented_features: Adds a book and shows it in the list
Deletes a book added by mistake
Lends a book and shows the borrower
Returns a book and clears the borrower
Filters to books currently lent out
Shows how many books are lent out
Preserves data across a browser refresh
assumptions: The category select is limited to Novel, Cookbook, and Reference as the examples given.
The 'Lend' action prompts for a borrower name and stores it in the Borrower field.
The 'Return' action clears the Borrower field.
Omitted multi-user or shared access: The idea states it is just the user on their own computer.
Omitted due dates or return deadlines: The idea only mentions noting the borrower and clearing it on return.
Search and alphabetical sorting are provided by the scaffold and are always available.
